Variable_Definitions: M_required_applicable = workload memory demand for the selected execution mode, memory placement and distribution strategy at the comparison granularity; M_available_applicable = usable hardware memory capacity at that same granularity and placement.
Units: GB (or another common capacity unit after explicit unit conversion)
Inputs: Workload-specific memory requirement; execution mode; placement/distribution strategy; applicable System_Memory_GB or GPU_Memory_Per_Accelerator_GB/GPU_Memory_Aggregate_GB where justified
Output: FEASIBLE when the applicable required memory is <= applicable available memory; otherwise INFEASIBLE. If the applicable pool/granularity cannot be established, return INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE.
Source_Type: Derived DSS Formula + Catalogue + Research + Official Vendor
Source_Title: Part 0 Memory Catalogue Audit; ZeRO; PagedAttention; Dell PowerEdge XE9680 Memory Specifications; NVIDIA H200 GPU; AMD Instinct MI300X Accelerator
Exact_Page_Section_Table_Equation: Derived DSS formula; informed by Part 0 Field Register and vendor/research evidence on device-specific memory and distributed placement.
Applicability: Part 1 capacity feasibility at per-device, per-host, or explicitly distributed/sharded granularity.
Limitations: This formula is a comparison gate, not a workload-memory estimator. It must not use aggregate GPU memory unless a supported distribution strategy maps the demand across devices. No safety margin, utilization percentage, or universal multiplier is embedded.
